plain: A clever trick used to deceive

webster.text: A trick or stratagem practiced for ensnaring or deception; a sly, insidious artifice.

example.quote: Against the insidious wiles of foreign influence (I conjure you to believe me, fellow-citizens) the jealousy of a free people ought to be constantly awake, since history and experience prove that foreign influence is one of the most baneful foes of republican government.
